name: talos-robot-webmcp
title: TALOS ESP32 Self-Balancing Robot WebMCP Server
description: Exposes real-time teleoperation, attitude telemetry, PID tuning, active leg posture articulation, and safety interlocks via the W3C Web Model Context Protocol (WebMCP) standard.

tools.name: talos_get_telemetry
tools.description: Fetch live sensor telemetry, balance orientation (pitch, roll), battery level, armed state, and subsystem health from the TALOS robot.

tools.name: talos_motion_command
tools.description: Drive the robot with directional bias (stop, forward, backward, left, right). The deterministic 200 Hz FreeRTOS loop maintains balance while moving.

tools.name: talos_set_speed
tools.description: Set driving throttle and motion effort percentage (0 to 100%).

tools.name: talos_set_armed
tools.description: Arm or disarm the balancing control loop. Arming activates the 200 Hz PID wheel motors. Disarming coasts the wheels safely.

armed.description: True to arm and balance, false to disarm into standby.

tools.name: talos_emergency_stop
tools.description: Immediate hardware emergency stop. Instantly disarms all wheel and leg actuators, cancels pending commands, and engages safety interlock.

tools.name: talos_set_leg_posture
tools.description: Articulate dual MG996R leg servos to adjust chassis ride height, ground clearance, and pitch trim.

legPosition.description: Leg extension percentage (0 = fully bent / low clearance, 100 = fully extended / high clearance).

tools.name: talos_toggle_leg_assist
tools.description: Enable or disable active dynamic balance leg assist. When active, leg servos dynamically flex to counteract tilt disturbances.

enabled.description: True to enable active leg stabilization assist, false to disable.

tools.name: talos_tune_pid
tools.description: Live-tune PID balance loop gains and wheel limits on the ESP32. Applied instantly over Wi-Fi/Firebase.

balanceTrimDeg.description: Zero-angle mechanical pitch trim in degrees.

predictionTimeMs.description: Filter lead prediction horizon in milliseconds.

maxWheelOutputUs.description: Max wheel servo pulse delta in microseconds.

minActiveWheelOutputUs.description: Deadband overcome pulse threshold in microseconds.

tools.name: talos_set_fall_limit
tools.description: Configure maximum tilt safety limit. Exceeding this pitch angle triggers auto-shutdown to protect motors.

limitDeg.description: Fall detection angle cutoff in degrees (30, 60, or 80).

tools.name: talos_set_mode
tools.description: Switch operational mode of the robot.

tools.name: talos_get_camera_feed
tools.description: Retrieve current ESP32-CAM video stream endpoint URL, relay status, and camera connection state.
